content: Boxo bitswap Client.GetBlocks (client.go, main, verified from raw source): 'When the provided context is canceled, GetBlocks will stop returning blocks and the returned channel will be closed.' Cancellation is SILENT - no error result delivered to the consumer; the only error return is for failure-to-begin within the context deadline. Session is auto-cleaned on completion/cancel. Observable contract: cancel = teardown without failure callback; genuine timeout/failure = error delivered exactly once via channel close or block channel semantics. Canceled wants are announced to peers as CANCEL wantlist entries (bitswap spec) so they stop serving.
